measured_on: 2026-11-06, against CM051 vendor/cm019_preferences and vendor/cm059_editor (main 366a7767), by tests/test_the_preference_seed_lands_both_rows.py
why: The walk carries this fixture itself (CM051 scripts/box_walk_probes/fixtures/preference_seed) and pairs it with the OS003 gates/seed loader, which still owns the write and the graph read-back.

The OS003 fixture it replaces seeded the clearing row as 8 Spotify PLAYS. Since CM051 #2921 (a play is not a like) the ingest aggregates plays to a NeutralPreference, and the loader counts pwg:LikePreference only, so the v1.0.124 and v1.0.125 walks read 'created 2, filtered 7, graph 1' and the seed exited 1.
Its second row (0.1732) also stopped being screened when the compiler floor moved from 0.28 to 0.10, so even a landed pair would have read suppressed=0 on a seed-only store.

synthetic.statement: Every string below is invented for this fixture. No real artist, release, recording, account or topic carries these names, and none of them names or describes a person, an organisation, a place or a message.
synthetic.how_to_check: The three strings are the only content in exports/. Read the two files.

graph_readback.note: One saved track (an explicit like) and one account liked twice parse to 2 rows and aggregate to 2 pwg:LikePreference rows. A post-count of 1 with the music row missing means the music row landed as something other than a Like (a play is Neutral since CM051 #2921); a post-count of 0 or 1 otherwise means a write was lost. The ingest exit code is not the verdict: services/ingest/src/loaders/oxigraph_loader.py returns False on a failed INSERT and the caller does not raise, so a failed write and a clean run print the same rc.

compiler.arithmetic: confidence = category_trust x source_trust x evidence_factor x recency_confidence. music 0.95 x spotify 0.45 (DEFAULT_SOURCE_TRUST) x 0.70 (1 observation, 1 source) x recency = 0.2992. social_media 0.30 x twitter 0.45 x 0.70 x ~1.0 = 0.0945 (an export with no date reads its fresh createdAt). The floor is compile_profile's default min_confidence (vendor/cm059_editor/compiler/interest_profile.py), which is what the box's build_from_live applies.
compiler.margins: The clearing row sits about +0.20 over the floor and the screened row about -0.006 under it. If a trust constant or the floor moves upstream, tests/test_the_preference_seed_lands_both_rows.py goes red before a walk does: read the printed confidence and the floor before calling it a walk failure.

does_not_clear: A passing seed here does NOT clear CM051 #1872. This fixture proves the preference write route carries a row from an export file into the graph and that the confidence screen keeps its floor. It says nothing about whether a real install ever RUNS an ingest over the exports a customer actually has.
